== Notes ==
* This skill is particularly useful at removing a [[deep removal|large amount]] of [[enchantments]] and is very effective against [[Monks]], [[Elementalists]], and [[Necromancers]] that use a lot of enchantments in [[PvP]].

== Trivia ==
{{Skill change}}
*During early development, this skill was called 'Rend Blessings', as mentioned by an alpha tester in the Photics e-zine Issue #5<ref>https://photics.com/issues/issue05.pdf</ref>.
